TychusMasteryQuarterback.name: Quarterback
TychusMasteryQuarterback.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

TychusMasteryRunandGunDash.name: Dash
TychusMasteryRunandGunDash.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

TychusPressTheAdvantage.name: Press the Advantage
TychusPressTheAdvantage.description: Increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.

TychusInTheRhythm.name: In the Rhythm
TychusInTheRhythm.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

TychusTheBiggerTheyAre.name: The Bigger They Are...
TychusTheBiggerTheyAre.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

TychusMasterAssassin.name: Master Assassin
TychusMasterAssassin.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%. Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

TychusMeltingPoint.name: Melting Point
TychusMeltingPoint.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

TychusCombatTactician.name: Combat Tactician
TychusCombatTactician.description: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

TychusRelentlessSoldier.name: Relentless Soldier
TychusRelentlessSoldier.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

TychusHeroicAbilityCommandeerOdin.name: Commandeer Odin
TychusHeroicAbilityCommandeerOdin.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

TychusHeroicAbilityDrakkenLaserDrill.name: Drakken Laser Drill
TychusHeroicAbilityDrakkenLaserDrill.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

TychusMasterySprayNPray.name: Spray 'n' Pray
TychusMasterySprayNPray.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

TychusThatsTheStuff.name: That's the Stuff!
TychusThatsTheStuff.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

TychusNeosteelCoating.name: Neosteel Coating
TychusNeosteelCoating.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

TychusMasteryOverkillArmorPiercingRounds.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
TychusMasteryOverkillArmorPiercingRounds.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

TychusMasteryFragGrenadeTitanGrenade.name: Titan Grenade
TychusMasteryFragGrenadeTitanGrenade.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

TychusSizzlinAttacks.name: Sizzlin' Attacks
TychusSizzlinAttacks.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

TychusMasteryOdinBigRedButton.name: Big Red Button
TychusMasteryOdinBigRedButton.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 damage in its area.

TychusMasteryDrakkenLaserFocusingDiodes.name: Focusing Diodes
TychusMasteryDrakkenLaserFocusingDiodes.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

TychusCanDoThisAllDayOverkillTalent.name: Can Do This All Day
TychusCanDoThisAllDayOverkillTalent.description: Reduce Overkill's cooldown by 5 seconds. While Channeling Overkill, Tychus gains 40 Armor.

TychusRunAndGunBobAndWeave.name: Bob and Weave
TychusRunAndGunBobAndWeave.description: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25. After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.
